{{Short description|Nonlinear partial differential equation}}
The '''KdV-Burgers-Fisher equation''' (or Koçak's equation) is a nonlinear [[partial differential equation]],

:<math>\displaystyle \partial_t u + \mu \partial_x^3 u + \epsilon u \partial_x u -\nu \partial_x^2 u = ru(1-u)</math>,

which combines different entities such as dispersion (from the [[Korteweg–de Vries equation]]), dissipation (from the [[Burgers' equation]]) and reaction (from the [[KPP–Fisher equation]]). The KdV-Burgers-Fisher equation is often abbreviated as the KBF equation or the KdVBF equation.<ref>{{cite journal | last=Koçak | first=Hüseyin | title=Traveling waves in nonlinear media with dispersion, dissipation, and reaction | journal=Chaos: An Interdisciplinary Journal of Nonlinear Science | volume=30 | issue=9 | date=2020 | doi=10.1063/5.0014891 | page=093143 | bibcode= }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | last1=Folino | first1=R. | last2=Naumkina | first2=A. | last3=Plaza | first3=R. G. | title=Instability of periodic waves for the Korteweg–de Vries–Burgers equation with monostable source | journal=Physica D: Nonlinear Phenomena | volume=467 | issue= | date=2024 | doi=10.1016/j.physd.2024.134234 | article-number=134234 | bibcode= | arxiv=2402.07789 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | last1=Esen | first1=A. | last2=Karaagac | first2=B. | last3=Yagmurlu | first3=N. M. | last4=Ucar | first4=Y. | last5=Manafian | first5=J. | title=A numerical aproach to dispersion-dissipation-reaction model: third order KdV-Burger-Fisher equation | journal=Physica Scripta | volume=99 | issue=8 | date=2024 | doi=10.1088/1402-4896/ad635c | page=085260 | bibcode= }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | last1=Sarthak | first1=S. | last2=Srinivasacharya | first2=D. | title=Physics-informed deep operator learning for long-time simulation of nonlinear partial differential equations via temporal domain decomposition | journal=Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence | volume=171 | issue= | date=2026 | doi=10.1016/j.engappai.2026.114261 | article-number=114261 | bibcode= }}</ref>
